results.title: Kong Tao
results.overview: Local property developer Song Longchen secretly employs black magic—known as Hexing—to seize control of valuable land parcels. His schemes leave behind a trail of unexplained deaths, which authorities dismiss as mere accidents due to widespread skepticism toward the supernatural.

results.title: Evolution
results.overview: When an alien substance mixes Zoe’s DNA with that of her exotic pets, a hilarious adventure begins where humans turn into animals, animals turn into humans, and everyone must come to an agreement to save the world.

results.title: Adopting St. Nick
results.overview: A single mother finds unexpected romance while helping her daughter connect with a Santa-like resident at a retirement community.

results.title: Silent Friend
results.overview: In the heart of a botanical garden in a medieval university town in Germany stands a majestic ginkgo tree. This silent witness has observed over a century the quiet rhythms of transformation across three human lives. At three distinct moments across the 20th and 21st centuries, these people — each carrying their own questions and inner struggles — inevitably find themselves drawn into the presence of this tree, full of mystery and meaning.

results.title: The Stunt Driver
results.overview: Based on a true story, a Canadian stunt driver recruits a top sports manager and rocket car designers to attempt a record-breaking jump across the Saint Lawrence River, hoping to achieve fame and fortune.

results.title: Band of Brothers: Legacy
results.overview: This tribute to the groundbreaking series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company and deepened public appreciation for the sacrifices of the Greatest Generation features new interviews with cast members Damian Lewis, Ron Livingston, Michael Cudlitz, Capt. Dale Dye, USMC (Ret.), David Schwimmer, and more. Through personal reflections and behind-the-scenes stories, participants revisit the experience of making the series and explore its lasting cultural resonance, and also includes never-before-seen archival footage and photographs of Easy Company and World War II.

results.title: Bitter Christmas
results.overview: During a long December holiday weekend, a woman, whose mother has recently died, throws herself into work as a form of escape. Her relentless pace is interrupted when a panic attack forces her to take a break.

results.title: Storm on Sesame Street
results.overview: As a big storm approaches, Elmo and friends work together to get ready. After it passes, Sesame Street looks different — and everyone pitches in to help.

results.title: Undercurrent
results.overview: An ambitious ecologist returning to her childhood home on the Dutch island of Ameland discovers a dangerous drug smuggling route, forcing her to choose between exposing the truth and protecting those she loves.

results.title: Roommates
results.overview: When shy college freshman Devon asks cool-girl Celeste to be her roommate, a blossoming friendship quickly spirals into a war of passive aggression.

results.original_title: In the Blink of an Eye
results.overview: Three storylines, spanning thousands of years, intersect and reflect on hope, connection, and the circle of life.

results.title: The Last First: Winter K2
results.overview: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.

results.title: In the Name of Love

results.overview: Follows a modern-day writer who slips back in time, inhabiting the body of Wanthong from the Thai classic Khun Chang Khun Phaen, and struggles to rewrite her destiny and avoid a tragic fate.

results.title: Chum
results.overview: A newlywed couple joins friends on a Mediterranean yacht excursion, only to find themselves caught between a predatory shark and a psychopathic killer in their midst-transforming a sun-drenched escape into a fight for survival.

results.title: Go Team!
results.overview: When their team-building event gets downgraded to a tiny village, a cheese company's staff think it can't get worse — then they learn about the layoffs.

results.title: I, Object
results.overview: 10-year-old Tom, grieving the loss of his father and unable to relate to the people in his life, takes refuge in the everyday objects around him. Pop can lids, suitcases and untold numbers of everyday objects reveal their true faces and speak to him, helping him on his healing journey.

results.title: Outcome
results.overview: Reef Hawk, Hollywood's poster child since age six, is not okay. When he learns about an extortion plot tied to a mysterious video, Reef preemptively sets out on a redemption tour to make amends, confront his demons, and avoid getting canceled.

results.title: The Truthers
results.overview: After her mother's sudden death, Ruth returns to her hometown and reunites with her father, whose odd behavior makes her question what really happened.
